programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u059/system/state/workspace/programs')

source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The nonzero horizontal bar is the base. Each 2/8 marker projects upward
    # as a short column, with a marker-colored cap and 1s beneath it.
    base = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)), None)
    if base is None:
        return out
    for c, color in enumerate(grid[base]):
        if color in (2, 8):
            height = 4 if color == 2 else 3
            for offset in range(1, height + 1):
                r = base - offset
                if r < 0:
                    break
                out[r][c] = color if offset == height else 1
    return out
'''
